_read_this_first: These are tier claims KNOWN to be unevidenced. They are counted and printed on every run; they only withhold the exit code. The register is a RATCHET: an unevidenced claim that is NOT listed here fails the gate, and an entry whose debt is gone (claim now evidenced, or row deleted) ALSO fails the gate. It can shrink; it cannot grow silently and it cannot outlive its reason.
_measured: 2026-08-08, ai_docs/2026-08-08-compat-envelope-baseline.md. At that commit: 6 qualifying claims across 4 scorecards, 0 evidenced. That 0-of-6 is the correct starting number for this gate -- the first honest measurement, not a regression.
_sequencing_rule: Do not expand envelope coverage until these entries are cleared. Growing a claim count whose own checker returns 0-of-6 grows a number nobody can defend.

unevidenced_claims.why: Claims full-stdout-info-stack-heap but carries evidence for only 1 of the 4 components it names. stdout: stdout_parity AND both SHA-256 operands (output_hash, ref_output_hash) are blank, so the comparison is unrecoverable from the row, not merely underived -- a PRODUCER gap. stack/heap: the schema has no stack_parity/heap_parity column; the row carries a single stack_hash and heap_hash with no reference operand, so a parity is inexpressible -- a SCHEMA gap that renaming would not fix. info_log IS evidenced (compared_log_messages, non-empty, equal counts). Registered by task wire-tier-evidence-checker-that-has-zero-callers so the gate can be wired without turning pre-existing debt into a day-one red. Clears when the producer writes the stdout operands and the schema gains stack/heap reference operands; at that point this entry MUST be deleted -- the checker fails on a stale entry.
